what: While-read body ends with `[[ -n "$v" ]] && STEP5_*="$v"` lists whose exit status is non-zero when the final key is absent on that line
scenario_or_breakage: Bash adopts the last executed body command status as the while compound status; with `set -e` active in `run_implement_loop` the shell can exit as soon as the while finishes, so post-loop `printf >&2` diagnostics are never reached and tests expecting stderr plus survival can fail
suggested_fix: Rewrite optional assignments as `if [[ -n "$v" ]]; then STEP5_*="$v"; fi` (or end each iteration with an explicit `true`) so the while always exits 0 for all inputs; relax the plan s "No other changes" line if it blocks this
